name: Sky Portal
line: A Django portal for an engineering org, with a live network map of which teams depend on which.

name: Smart Campus API
line: A REST API for rooms, sensors and their readings. JAX-RS on embedded Jetty, nothing but memory.

name: Nuntius
line: Explored email spoofing through a small web form. Retired once SPF, DKIM and DMARC bounced every message, which was the lesson.

name: Movie Barcode
line: Turns any video into a barcode of its colours, one stripe per frame. Python, v1.5.

name: ModSec WAF
line: One script that turns a Linux VM into a web application firewall. Tested with a target, a WAF and an attacker on one network.
